subject: Invoice routing & PO for renewal + capacity add (SaaS-TRI-4121)
messages:
From: Dana Liu <dana.liu@triloft.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@triloft.com
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal & capacity add — PO and invoicing details needed (SaaS-TRI-4121)

Hi Vivek,

Weare ready to move forward on the renewal and the additional committed capacity we discussed (addl. 200k committed tokens, start date 2027-08-01). Procurement asked me to confirm billing details so they can issue a PO and route payment. Can you confirm the following so we can generate the PO?

- Legal entity to invoice (company name exactly)
- Remit address for invoices
- Redwood W-9 or equivalent tax form (we need it attached to the PO)
- Can Redwood accept Net45 on this renewal?
- Draft invoice for the full term + prorated charge for Aug start (so procurement can code cost centers)

Weintend to issue a single PO but may request the invoice be split across two cost centers (CC-430 / CC-431) on your invoice lines. Please advise if that is OK.

Thanks,
Dana Liu
Sr. Manager, Finance (Triloft)
accounts.payable@triloft.com
Tel: +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Dana Liu <dana.liu@triloft.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity add — PO and invoicing details needed (SaaS-TRI-4121)

Hi Dana,

Thanks — great to hear. Quick answers below and Ive attached the documents you asked for: Redwood_W9_2027.pdf and a draft invoice showing the committed + prorate (draft-invoice-TRI-4121.pdf).

- Legal entity to invoice: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Remit address: 425 Market St, Suite 1100, San Francisco, CA 94105
- W-9 attached (Redwood_W9_2027.pdf)
- We can accept Net45 for renewals but we need a signed amendment for the billing terms when the PO is processed. Ive added Marissa (sales ops) to help with the amendment and to update the invoice split.

On the prorate: we show the committed capacity starting 2027-08-01; the draft invoice includes a prorated charge for 08/01-08/31. If procurement sends the PO number and confirms the two cost center codes, well issue a final invoice with split lines as requested.

Next steps:
1) Send PO number + confirm cost center split
2) Procurement signs the DocuSign amendment (link will be provided by Marissa)
3) We finalize and send official invoice PDF (with line items for each cost center)

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachments: Redwood_W9_2027.pdf (W-9), draft-invoice-TRI-4121.pdf (draft invoice)

Triloft Technologies, Inc.
